## User task / 使用场景

What is the user trying to accomplish, and which Homes or agents are involved?

## Current behavior or workaround / 当前做法

## Proposed improvement / 建议

For learning features, explain who owns the knowledge, what evidence is available,
and when it should become active. For examples, use fictional or authorized anonymized data.

## How to verify it / 验收方式

Describe an observable result, including relevant failure cases.

## Alternatives and scope / 替代方案与范围
